parameters.name: CACertificateId
parameters.description: The ID of the CA certificate.

parameters.name: CACertificateName
parameters.description:
The CA certificate name.

The name must be 1 to 80 character in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the CA certificate.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb set-ca-certificate-name --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ca-certificate-id 139a0000000-cn-east-hangzhou-01 --ca-certificate-name mycacert02 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
